about: LOD 400 timber door frame with transom and fanlight/vent over (Uganda everyday door). Height is the overall frame height; leaf top = Height - Fanlight Height. Type-dependent parts (louvres vs glass, mosquito mesh, raised panels) are switched by Yes/No-driven formulas that collapse the part into the left jamb when off, until the engine has a visibility-parameter op. The recipe puts its outer face at -y, but the template's plane named Exterior is at +y (field review, 15 Oct): the Revit retest confirms which way the family faces in a wall; the leaf is flush with the interior face and swings in. Profile slot (gen_profile_slots.py): FMC_Design_Movement (1-20, default 17) shows one of 20 Architrave sweeps (Ext and Int faces) from FMC_Profile_Architrave_<Token>, each bound to Show_<Token>. Each sweep's path is locked to Left, Right, Frame Head and Floor (path_planes) on Frame Ext/Frame Int, so the trims follow Width and Height in every type. The plain architrave shows only when FMC_Design_Movement is outside 1-20.

ops.name: Louvre L Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Frame Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Louvre R Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Glass L Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Hide Offset, Frame Width)

ops.name: Glass R Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Hide Offset + Hide Width, Width - Frame Width)

ops.name: Mesh R Offset
ops.formula: if(FMC_Mosquito_Mesh, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Panel L Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Panelled, Frame Width + Panel Margin, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Panel R Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Panelled, Frame Width + Main Leaf Width - Panel Margin, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: FMC_Glazed_Area_m2
ops.formula: (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Fanlight Height - Transom Depth - Frame Width) * if(Vent Louvred, 0, 1)
